WorldObjectDef.label: automated listening post
WorldObjectDef.description: A self-contained, unmanned early-warning radar relay powered by high-capacity solar battery banks. Sweeps the surrounding sector across 12 planetary traversal rings, transmitting real-time tracking telemetry directly to the colony's planetary geoscape grid. Consumes zero local colony TPS.

WorldObjectDef.label: signal beacon
WorldObjectDef.description: An unmanned timber or stone signal beacon established on the planetary surface. Signal bonfires provide early-warning movement detection across 6 traversal rings. Because it is unmanned, it provides zero identification capabilities. Elevated high ground grants organic vantage range bonuses. Consumes zero local colony TPS.

WorldObjectDef.label: automated sonar station
WorldObjectDef.description: A dedicated coastal hydrophone and acoustic telemetry installation deployed adjacent to a body of water. Projects directional V-shaped sonar arrays across connected ocean and sea tiles up to 18 traversal rings, detecting and classifying maritime and submerged contacts without requiring a settlement.
